scalars.scalar_value: Two years of recent experience in a high-volume laboratory setting – preferred

24 hours/week, consisting of three 8-hour shifts from 3:00pm - 11:30pm. Scheduled workdays will be a fixed schedule of either Monday-Wednesday or Wednesday-Friday. Rotating weekends and holidays are required.

items.item_text: Current, valid California Clinical Laboratory Scientist license
Two years of recent experience in a high-volume laboratory setting – preferred

Join our team as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist where you will conduct various technical procedures in the Anesthesiology, Core Laboratory, Special Chemistry, and Point of Care. Your primary duties include specimen processing, method development, testing across multiple areas such as chemistry, hematology, coagulation, immunoassay, and blood gases. You will also be responsible for maintaining laboratory instruments, performing quality control, calibration, reagent preparation, and data entry.
Demonstrated technical competence in high-volume chemistry/hematology
Proficiency in practical application of fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions for making reagents and calculations
Must pass the Ishihara Color Vision exam, i.e. visual acuity including color differentiation
Ability to work rotating weekends and holidays
Working knowledge of lab safety, basic lab skills (e.g., pipetting, dilutions, specimen integrity), and test methodologies
Ability to perform repetitive tasks such as pipetting and computer data entry
